baslik: What Lightning Really Does to a Building
aciklama:
Lightning is five times hotter than the sun and can blow concrete apart. Here is how it destroys.

#shorts #science #lightning #nature #howitworks

sahneler.metin: A single lightning bolt is five times hotter than the sun.
When it hits a tree, the tree can explode.
A billion volts, in just a fraction of a second.
Why? It always takes the fastest path down.
If that path runs through water, it boils it instantly.
Trapped moisture flashes to steam and blows brick and wood apart.
Lightning rods give it a safe metal path down.
Without one, the bolt makes its own path, through anything.

vaka.yanilgi: Lightning rods don't attract lightning — they give a strike that's already coming a safe path to the ground.
